cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The lift's broken. We can cancel the gym and use the stairs.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A treats transport inconvenience as a pupil opportunity to invent a cheaper combined exercise routine, crediting its own teaching.
confusable: Unlike general optimism, each cheerful interpretation produces a concrete efficiency saving.
comparison: Apartment stairs and groceries as exercise versus edible serving dishes under appliance failure.
